name: Integrate Rybbit
author: Maki IT

sections.description:
Add and manage the Rybbit tracking script for WordPress. Configure privacy, role exclusions, and script attributes.

External services

This plugin integrates with the Rybbit analytics service to provide tracking functionality.

If you don’t host your own Rybbit instance, data collected by this plugin will be sent to the Rybbit servers for processing.
This includes tracking data such as page views, user interactions, and other analytics information.
See the Rybbit Data Processing Agreement to find out more about how Rybbit handles the tracking data.

By using this plugin, you agree to Rybbit’s terms of service and privacy policy.

Third-party assets / trademarks

This is a free and open-source WordPress plugin developed independently for integration with Rybbit.
The use of the Rybbit name and logo in this plugin has been explicitly approved by the owner of Rybbit.
All Rybbit trademarks, logos, and brand assets remain the property of their respective owner.

This plugin is not an official Rybbit product and is not otherwise affiliated with or endorsed by Rybbit.

License

GPLv3 or later
sections.installation:
1. Upload and install the Plugin zip archive via the Admin UI or extract the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/integrate-rybbit directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under Settings > Integrate Rybbit.
sections.faq:
How do I get my Site ID?

Find your Site ID in your Rybbit dashboard under tracking settings.
